schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE dipartimenti (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    edificio TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE studenti (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    matricola TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_immatricolazione DATE NOT NULL,
    tutor_id INT REFERENCES studenti(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    CHECK (tutor_id IS NULL OR tutor_id <> id)
);

CREATE TABLE corsi (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    codice TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    titolo TEXT NOT NULL,
    cfu INT NOT NULL CHECK (cfu BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
    dipartimento_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES dipartimenti(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE esami (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    studente_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES studenti(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    corso_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES corsi(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    data_esame DATE NOT NULL,
    voto INT NOT NULL CHECK (voto BETWEEN 18 AND 30),
    lode BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);
